narration.allowedTopic: thanking the child for repairing the harbor bridge
narration.fallbackText: You fixed my bridge! Every crew in the bay walks across it now. Thank you, friend.

dialogue.text: You fixed my bridge! Every crew in the bay walks across it now. Thank you, friend.
Good to see you again. The bridge is still broken. Would you help me count the planks?
Ahoy! I am Pip, and this is my shipyard. There is always something to build here.

choices.label: That sounds like a big job!

dialogue.text: The bridge to the cove lost half its planks in the last storm. I need someone good at counting to help me build it back.

questOffers.summary: Help Pip count and measure planks to repair the harbor bridge.

npcs.role: Shipyard foreman at Pirate Builder Bay. Offers the bridge repair quest.

dialogue.text: The story you made is on my shelf now. Shall we start a new one?

narration.allowedTopic: welcoming the child into the castle library full of unfinished stories
narration.fallbackText: Welcome to the castle library. Every story here is missing one thing: your ideas.

dialogue.text: Welcome to the castle library. Every story here is missing one thing: your ideas.

questOffers.summary: Build a story with Keeper Quill, one choice at a time.

npcs.role: Storykeeper Castle librarian. Invites children to build a story together.

dialogue.text: My favorite helper is back. I saved the interesting gears for you.

narration.allowedTopic: introducing a cluttered workshop full of springs and gears
narration.fallbackText: Careful where you step, there are springs everywhere. I am Bolt. I fix things.

dialogue.text: Careful where you step, there are springs everywhere. I am Bolt. I fix things.

questOffers.summary: Help Bolt sort the workshop parts into the right bins.

npcs.role: Tinkerer at Bolt's Workshop. Offers building and sorting work.

narration.allowedTopic: a dragon delighted that the sanctuary forge is burning again
narration.fallbackText: Look at it! Warm all the way to the back wall. I had almost stopped believing it would light again. Thank you.

dialogue.text: Look at it! Warm all the way to the back wall. I had almost stopped believing it would light again. Thank you.

choices.label: I will go and set them.

narration.allowedTopic: a dragon urging the child to set three found runes into the forge hearth
narration.fallbackText: All three! You found all three. Take them to the hearth and set them in the sockets. I would do it myself, but my claws are far too big for the little slots.

dialogue.text: All three! You found all three. Take them to the hearth and set them in the sockets. I would do it myself, but my claws are far too big for the little slots.

narration.allowedTopic: a dragon describing where three fire runes came to rest around the valley
narration.fallbackText: Three fire runes, and they are not lost so much as scattered. One rolled behind the Keeper Lodge. One is down among the boulders. And one is out on the cold ledge where you can see the sky cliffs.

dialogue.text: Three fire runes, and they are not lost so much as scattered. One rolled behind the Keeper Lodge. One is down among the boulders. And one is out on the cold ledge where you can see the sky cliffs.
You are the one who helped me. I remember. This sanctuary is yours to visit anytime.

narration.allowedTopic: a dragon explaining that the sanctuary forge went out and needs three missing runes
narration.fallbackText: The forge went out. That is what happened. Everything here ran on its warmth, and when it stopped, the hatchery went cold and the others left one by one. I cannot light it. It needs its three fire runes, and I cannot find them.

dialogue.text: The forge went out. That is what happened. Everything here ran on its warmth, and when it stopped, the hatchery went cold and the others left one by one. I cannot light it. It needs its three fire runes, and I cannot find them.

npcs.role: Young dragon at the Dragon's Sanctuary. Appears only after the Ember Mountain story, and asks the child to help relight the forge.

narration.allowedTopic: thanking the child for relighting the harbor lighthouse
narration.fallbackText: You got the old lamp turning! Ships have been coming in all morning. I will not forget it.

dialogue.text: You got the old lamp turning! Ships have been coming in all morning. I will not forget it.

narration.allowedTopic: asking the child for help restarting the lighthouse machine
narration.fallbackText: I cannot open the gate while the lighthouse is dark. Would you take a look at the machine?

dialogue.text: I cannot open the gate while the lighthouse is dark. It would not be safe. The machine inside stopped, and I am no good with machines. Would you take a look?

narration.allowedTopic: welcoming the child to a harbor town whose machines have stopped
narration.fallbackText: Welcome to Clockwork Harbor. It is quieter than it should be. Half the town has stopped ticking.

dialogue.text: Welcome to Clockwork Harbor. It is quieter than it should be, I am afraid. Half the town has stopped ticking.

narration.allowedTopic: explaining that the harbor gate stays shut while the lighthouse is dark
narration.fallbackText: The lighthouse stopped. No light, no safe way in, so the gate stays shut and the ships wait.

dialogue.text: The lighthouse stopped, is what happened. No light, no safe way in, so the gate stays shut and the ships wait out there in the dark. The machine that turns it is inside, and it is beyond me.

questOffers.summary: Help the Harbor Master get the lighthouse turning again.

npcs.role: Keeper of the harbor gate at Clockwork Harbor. Offers the lighthouse repair quest.

narration.allowedTopic: hinting that something older beneath the harbor is still failing
narration.fallbackText: The lamp is turning! But that is not the real trouble. Something older, further down, is running badly.

dialogue.text: The lamp is turning! Good. But listen - that is not the real trouble. Something much older, much further down, is running badly. Can you hear it?

narration.allowedTopic: an inventor puzzling over harbor machinery that has started failing
narration.fallbackText: Gears, gears, gears. Everything here runs on them, and lately they run backward, or not at all.

dialogue.text: Gears, gears, gears. Everything here runs on them, and lately they run backward, or not at all. I have three notebooks full of it and no answer yet.

npcs.role: Inventor at Clockwork Harbor. Explains how the harbor machinery works.
